main.content {

.cell-output-display,

/* Report identity banner: preserve the custom header card exactly. */
.report-identity-card {
  margin: 0 0 2rem;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem 1.35rem;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eef3f8 0%, #e3ebf3 100%);
  border: 1px solid #cbd7e3;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(31, 45, 61, 0.08);
}

.report-identity-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
  font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 2.7vw, 2.65rem);
  line-height: 1.12;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: #1f2937;
}

.report-identity-subtitle {
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: #526171;
}

.report-identity-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

/* Metadata/indicator boxes: align with the Journal theme while leaving the
   outer header card colors unchanged. */
.report-identity-item {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.9rem 1.15rem;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  font-family: inherit;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}

.report-identity-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 auto 0 0;
  width: 0.22rem;
  background: #375a7f;
}

.report-identity-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #666666;
}

.report-identity-value {
  display: block;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #222222;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.report-identity-item:hover {
  border-color: #375a7f;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);
  transform: translateY(-1px);

/* Interactive core-gene tabs. */

<script>
(() => {
  function activateGeneTab(tab) {
    const tabset = tab.closest('.gene-tabset');
    if (!tabset) return;
    const tabs = Array.from(tabset.querySelectorAll('.gene-tab[role="tab"]'));
    const panels = Array.from(tabset.querySelectorAll('.gene-tab-panel[role="tabpanel"]'));
    const targetId = tab.getAttribute('data-target') || tab.getAttribute('aria-controls');
    if (!targetId) return;

    tabs.forEach((candidate) => {
      const active = candidate === tab;
      candidate.classList.toggle('active', active);
      candidate.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
      candidate.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
    });

    panels.forEach((panel) => {
      const active = panel.id === targetId;
      panel.hidden = !active;
      panel.classList.toggle('active', active);
      if (active) panel.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
      else panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    });
  }

  function initializeGeneTabs() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.gene-tabset').forEach((tabset) => {
      const tabs = Array.from(tabset.querySelectorAll('.gene-tab[role="tab"]'));
      if (!tabs.length || tabset.dataset.tabsInitialized === 'true') return;

      tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {
        tab.tabIndex = tab.classList.contains('active') ? 0 : -1;
        tab.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
          let next = null;
          if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'ArrowDown') next = tabs[(index + 1) % tabs.length];
          if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowUp') next = tabs[(index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length];
          if (event.key === 'Home') next = tabs[0];
          if (event.key === 'End') next = tabs[tabs.length - 1];
          if (next) {
            event.preventDefault();
            next.focus();
            activateGeneTab(next);
          }
          if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
            event.preventDefault();
            activateGeneTab(tab);
          }
        });
      });

      tabset.dataset.tabsInitialized = 'true';
    });
  }

  // Delegate clicks so tabs also work when Quarto/Jupyter inserts output
  // after the initial DOMContentLoaded event.
  document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const tab = event.target.closest?.('.gene-tab[role="tab"]');
    if (tab) {
      event.preventDefault();
      activateGeneTab(tab);
    }
  });

  const geneTabObserver = new MutationObserver(() => initializeGeneTabs());
  geneTabObserver.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  function positionReportIdentityCard() {
    const main = document.querySelector('#quarto-document-content');
    const card = main?.querySelector('.report-identity-card');
    if (!main || !card) return;
    // Move the custom sample/metadata card to the very top of the report.
    main.prepend(card);
    const title = card.querySelector('.report-identity-title');
    if (title?.textContent.trim()) document.title = title.textContent.trim();
  }

  function hidePreIdentityCodeFolds() {
    const card = document.querySelector('.report-identity-card');
    const allFolds = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('details.code-fold'));
    if (!card) return;
    // The first four code-fold cells are the parameter/setup cells. Hide only
    // those four; code-folds later in the report remain available.
    allFolds.slice(0, 4).forEach((fold) => {
      const cell = fold.closest('.cell');
      if (cell) cell.style.display = 'none';
    });
  }

  function syncReportTitle() {
    const title = document.querySelector('.report-identity-title');
    if (title) document.title = title.textContent.trim();
  }
  function initializeReportHeader() {
    positionReportIdentityCard();
    hidePreIdentityCodeFolds();
    syncReportTitle();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeReportHeader, { once: true });
  } else {
    initializeReportHeader();
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', initializeReportHeader, { once: true });

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeGeneTabs, { once: true });
  } else {
    initializeGeneTabs();
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', initializeGeneTabs, { once: true });

  function setupReportTables() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.report-table-scroll').forEach((container, tableIndex) => {
      const table = container.querySelector('table.report-data-table');
      if (!table || table.dataset.interactiveReady === 'true') return;

      table.dataset.interactiveReady = 'true';
      const thead = table.querySelector('thead');
      const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
      if (!thead || !tbody) return;

      const tools = document.createElement('div');
      tools.className = 'report-table-tools';

      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'search';
      input.className = 'report-table-filter';
      input.placeholder = 'Filter table...';
      input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Filter table');

      const count = document.createElement('span');
      count.className = 'report-table-count';

      tools.append(input, count);
      container.parentNode.insertBefore(tools, container);

      let sortColumn = -1;
      let sortAscending = true;

      const rows = () => Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll('tr'));
      const updateCount = () => {
        const visible = rows().filter(row => row.style.display !== 'none').length;
        count.textContent = `${visible} of ${rows().length} rows`;
      };

      input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        const term = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        rows().forEach(row => {
          row.style.display = !term || row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(term) ? '' : 'none';
        });
        updateCount();
      });

      thead.querySelectorAll('th').forEach((th, column) => {
        th.title = 'Click to sort';
        th.addEventListener('click', () => {
          sortAscending = sortColumn === column ? !sortAscending : true;
          sortColumn = column;
          const sorted = rows().sort((a, b) => {
            const av = a.cells[column]?.textContent.trim() ?? '';
            const bv = b.cells[column]?.textContent.trim() ?? '';
            const an = Number(av.replace(/,/g, ''));
            const bn = Number(bv.replace(/,/g, ''));
            const bothNumeric = av !== '' && bv !== '' && Number.isFinite(an) && Number.isFinite(bn);
            const cmp = bothNumeric
              ? an - bn
              : av.localeCompare(bv, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
            return sortAscending ? cmp : -cmp;
          });
          sorted.forEach(row => tbody.appendChild(row));
          updateCount();
        });
      });

      updateCount();
      void tableIndex;
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupReportTables);
  } else {
    setupReportTables();
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', setupReportTables);
})();
</script>

```{python}
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import pickle
import re
from dataclasses import fields, is_dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Image, Markdown, display

if not config_pickle:
    raise ValueError(
        "The Quarto report requires config_pickle so it can load the saved "
        "PipelineConfig without inferring the run date."
    )

CONFIG_PICKLE = Path(config_pickle).expanduser().resolve()
if not CONFIG_PICKLE.is_file():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Pipeline configuration was not found at: {CONFIG_PICKLE}"
    )

with open(CONFIG_PICKLE, "rb") as f:
    CONFIG = pickle.load(f)

# PipelineConfig is the source of truth for the run identity. The report
# never derives run_date from the current date or from Quarto's render date.
# The report only uses values loaded from the saved configuration.
WORKING_DIR = Path(CONFIG.working_dir).expanduser().resolve()
WORKSPACE_DIR = WORKING_DIR / "workspace_files"
QC_DIR = WORKING_DIR / "qc_images"
CLUSTER_DIR = WORKING_DIR / "cluster_analysis"

# Use the run_date stored in the saved PipelineConfig when resolving the
# metadata artifact. The QMD never uses today's date or Quarto's render date.
metadata_pickle = (
    WORKSPACE_DIR
    / f"analysis_metadata_{CONFIG.save_prefix}_{CONFIG.run_date}.pkl"
)

if metadata_pickle.exists():
    with open(metadata_pickle, "rb") as f:
        ANALYSIS_METADATA = pickle.load(f)
else:
    ANALYSIS_METADATA = {}


def report_identity_card():
    sample = display_value(getattr(CONFIG, "sample_name", None))
    platform = display_value(getattr(CONFIG, "platform", None))
    run_date = display_value(getattr(CONFIG, "run_date", None))
    config_name = str(CONFIG_PICKLE.name)
    title = f"{sample} scRNA-seq Pre-Sample Pre-processing Report"
    return HTML(f"""
    <section class="report-identity-card" aria-label="Report identity">
      <h1 class="report-identity-title">{title}</h1>
      <p class="report-identity-subtitle">Pre-sample preprocessing and pipeline report</p>
      <div class="report-identity-grid">
        <div class="report-identity-item">
          <span class="report-identity-label">Sample</span>
          <span class="report-identity-value">{sample}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="report-identity-item">
          <span class="report-identity-label">Author</span>
          <span class="report-identity-value">Automated pipeline report</span>
        </div>
        <div class="report-identity-item">
          <span class="report-identity-label">Platform</span>
          <span class="report-identity-value">{platform}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="report-identity-item">
          <span class="report-identity-label">Run date</span>
          <span class="report-identity-value">{run_date}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="report-identity-item">
          <span class="report-identity-label">Report configuration</span>
          <span class="report-identity-value">{config_name}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    """)

def display_value(value):
    """Make config/metadata values readable without changing the stored values."""
    if value is None:
        return "None"
    if isinstance(value, Path):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        if not value:
            return "()" if isinstance(value, tuple) else "[]"
        return ", ".join(display_value(v) for v in value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return json.dumps(value, default=str)
    return str(value)

def metadata_summary(keys):
    rows = []
    for key in keys:
        value = ANALYSIS_METADATA.get(key, "Not found in saved analysis metadata")
        summary = display_value(value)
        interpretation = {
            "total_mito_genes": "Number of genes identified by the mitochondrial regex. Review the regex if this number is unexpectedly small or broad.",
            "total_ribo_genes": "Number of genes identified by the ribosomal pattern list. This is primarily a feature-annotation check.",
            "predicted_singlets": "Number of cells classified as singlets by ScDblFinder.",
            "predicted_doublets": "Number of cells classified as doublets by ScDblFinder; compare the fraction with the expected technology/loading rate.",
            "total_cells_prefilter": "Starting number of cells entering the filtering step.",
            "total_genes_prefilter": "Starting number of gene features entering the filtering step.",
            "total_cells_remaining_postfilter": "Cells retained after the configured QC and optional doublet-removal rules.",
            "total_genes_remaining_postfilter": "Gene features retained after cell filtering; gene count changes mainly if the object representation changes upstream.",
            "genes_ignored_for_hvg_selection": "Genes deliberately excluded from HVG selection by the configured regex, commonly to avoid clonotype-driven clustering bias.",
            "pcs_to_use": "Automated PCA cutoff used as the input dimensionality for neighborhood construction.",
        }.get(key, "Run-specific output recorded by the pipeline.")
        rows.append({"Metadata key": key, "Saved value / summary": summary, "General interpretation": interpretation})
    return rows


def show_table(rows):
    if not rows:
        display(Markdown("_No step-specific `analysis_metadata` entries are generated by this function._"))
        return

    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    html = df.to_html(
        index=False,
        escape=True,
        classes=["report-data-table"],
        border=0,
    )
    display(HTML(f"""
    <div class=\"report-table-scroll\" role=\"region\" aria-label=\"Scrollable report table\" tabindex=\"0\">
      {html}
    </div>
    """))


def show_images(image_specs, width=1600):
    found = 0
    for filename, title, interpretation in image_specs:
        matches = list(QC_DIR.rglob(filename)) + list(CLUSTER_DIR.rglob(filename))
        if not matches:
            continue
        found += 1
        image_path = matches[0]
        display(Markdown(f"#### {title}"))
        display(Image(filename=str(image_path), width=width))
        display(Markdown(f"**How to read it.** {interpretation}"))
    return found


def resolution_plot_groups():
    groups = []
    if CLUSTER_DIR.exists():
        for resolution_dir in sorted(CLUSTER_DIR.iterdir()):
            if not resolution_dir.is_dir():
                continue
            umaps = sorted(resolution_dir.glob("*_initial_umap.png"))
            violins = sorted(resolution_dir.glob("*_normalized_expression_violin_plot.png"))
            if umaps or violins:
                groups.append((resolution_dir.name, umaps, violins))
    return groups
```

# Run overview

This report documents the pipeline as implemented in the supplied code. The pipeline proceeds from input ingestion through QC, filtering, normalization, cell-cycle scoring, highly variable gene selection, PCA, and neighborhood/UMAP/Leiden analysis. The report is intended as a reproducibility and interpretation aid; it does not replace biological review of the underlying data.

```{python}
summary_rows = [
    {"Item": "Working directory", "Value": str(WORKING_DIR)},

]
```

::: {.callout-note}
### Reading this report

The most useful workflow is to start with the parameter table, then inspect each step in order. Within each step, the **analysis metadata** table is the compact run-specific summary, while the figures provide the visual context. The interpretation text describes what a metric or figure means in general; it is deliberately not a claim that the particular run is good or bad.
:::

## Step 1 — QC metrics and metadata


::: {.callout-warning}
### How to interpret this step

The goal is to characterize cell quality before any filtering decision is made. Count depth, genes detected, and mitochondrial percentage are complementary QC variables. Review distributions across samples rather than relying on a single global summary, and pay attention to long tails and extreme outliers. Doublet classification is a model-based prediction and should be treated as evidence requiring context, not as ground truth.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### How to interpret this step

Filtering changes the cell population, so evaluate both the retained fraction and the shape of the retained distributions. A large reduction is not automatically problematic, but it should be explainable by the QC distributions and the configured thresholds. When doublet removal is enabled, the post-filter population should reflect the chosen singlet-only policy.

## Step 3 — Normalize and transform

```{python}
step = PIPELINE_STEPS[3]
print(step["description"])
```

::: {.callout-warning}
### How to interpret this step

Normalization is intended to reduce dependence of expression values on sequencing depth, while `log1p` compresses the dynamic range and makes downstream modeling/visualization more stable. The raw count matrix is retained in the `counts` layer, which is important for traceability and for analyses that require integer-like counts.
:::

### How to interpret this step

Cell-cycle scoring summarizes expression of predefined S-phase and G2/M programs. High scores indicate that a cell's expression resembles the corresponding gene program. The current pipeline computes the scores but does not automatically regress them from the expression matrix in this step.

## Step 5 — Highly variable genes, regression, and scaling

```{python}

```

::: {.callout-warning}
### How to interpret this step

Highly variable genes are selected to retain features that vary across cells and can therefore contribute to downstream structure. The pipeline then excludes genes matching the configured ignore regex. In the supplied configuration this is designed to reduce clustering bias from immunoglobulin/clonotype genes during relevant B-cell analyses. The final active matrix is regressed and scaled before PCA.
:::

## Step 6 — PCA

```{python}

print(step["description"])
```

::: {.callout-warning}
### How to interpret this step

PCA compresses the expression matrix into orthogonal axes ordered by variance explained. The variance profile is useful for deciding how many PCs are worth carrying into the neighborhood graph. The loading plot helps identify which genes contribute to the first PCs and therefore what biological or technical programs may be shaping the dominant axes.
:::

## Step 7 — Neighbors, UMAP, and Leiden clustering

```{python}
step = PIPELINE_STEPS[7]
print(step["description"])
```

::: {.callout-warning}
### How to interpret this step

The neighborhood graph is the basis for clustering and UMAP. UMAP is primarily a visualization of local neighborhood relationships, so apparent distances and cluster shapes should not be treated as direct global biological distances. Leiden resolution controls granularity: lower resolution tends to produce fewer/broader clusters, while higher resolution tends to produce more granular partitions. Stability across nearby resolutions and coherence of marker expression are usually more informative than simply maximizing the number of clusters.
:::

```{python}
# Gene-specific clustrees are generated at the global clustering level by the pipeline.
# Keep the overall clustree above, then put each gene-specific clustree in its own
# collapsed accordion so a large marker set does not make the report excessively long.
def image_data_uri(path):
    import base64
    mime = "image/png"
    encoded = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:{mime};base64,{encoded}"


global_clustree_genes = []
if CLUSTER_DIR.exists():
    for clustree_path in sorted(CLUSTER_DIR.glob("clustree_*.png")):
        if clustree_path.name == "clustree_overall_stability.png":
            continue
        if clustree_path.is_file():
            gene_name = clustree_path.stem.replace("clustree_", "", 1)
            global_clustree_genes.append((gene_name, clustree_path))

if global_clustree_genes:
    display(Markdown("**Gene-specific cluster stability.** Expand a gene to inspect how that marker's expression is distributed across the clustering resolutions. These views are supplementary to the overall clustree and are most useful for evaluating whether a marker's cluster association persists or fragments as resolution changes."))

    clustree_html = []
    for gene_name, clustree_path in global_clustree_genes:
        uri = image_data_uri(clustree_path)
        clustree_html.extend([
            "<details class='global-gene-details'>",
            f"<summary><strong>{gene_name}</strong></summary>",
            "<div class='global-gene-panel'>",
            f"<figure class='global-gene-figure'><img src='{uri}' alt='Clustree stability for {gene_name}'></figure>",
            "<p><strong>How to read it.</strong> Follow the marker-associated cluster structure across increasing Leiden resolution. A marker that remains concentrated in a coherent branch across nearby resolutions provides more stable evidence of cluster association; repeated splitting, broad redistribution, or abrupt changes suggest that the marker alone should not drive resolution choice or annotation.</p>",
            "</div>",
            "</details>",
        ])

    display(HTML("".join(clustree_html)))
```

### Resolution-specific results

The pipeline creates a directory for each Leiden resolution and stores a labeled UMAP plus one normalized-expression violin plot for each configured core gene. These plots are the most direct place to compare cluster separation, marker localization, and expression distributions at a particular resolution.

```{python}
resolution_groups = resolution_plot_groups()
if not resolution_groups:
    display(Markdown("_No resolution-specific plots were found in `cluster_analysis/`._"))
else:
    display(Markdown("Each Leiden resolution is collapsed by default. Expand a resolution to inspect its clustered UMAP and core-gene violin plots. Within each resolution, use the gene tabs to move between markers."))

    html_parts = []
    for idx, (resolution_name, umaps, violins) in enumerate(resolution_groups):
        html_parts.append(
            f"<details class='resolution-details'>"
            f"<summary><strong>Leiden resolution {resolution_name}</strong></summary>"
            "<div class='resolution-panel'>"
            "<p><strong>How to read this resolution.</strong> Review whether the partitioning is stable and interpretable, whether clusters have coherent marker expression, and whether QC variables are disproportionately defining any cluster.</p>"
        )

        if umaps:
            html_parts.append("<h4>Clustered UMAP</h4>")
            for p in umaps:
                uri = image_data_uri(p)
                html_parts.append(
                    f"<figure class='resolution-figure'><img src='{uri}' alt='Leiden {resolution_name} clustered UMAP'></figure>"
                )

        if violins:
            html_parts.append("<h4>Core-gene violin plots</h4>")
            gene_tabs_id = f"resolution-{idx}-gene-tabs"
            html_parts.append(f"<div class='gene-tabset' id='{gene_tabs_id}'>")
            html_parts.append("<div class='gene-tablist' role='tablist' aria-label='Core gene plots'>")

            gene_panels = []
            for gene_idx, p in enumerate(violins):
                suffix = "_normalized_expression_violin_plot.png"
                gene = p.name[:-len(suffix)] if p.name.endswith(suffix) else p.stem
                gene_safe = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "-", gene).strip("-") or str(gene_idx)
                gene_panel_id = f"{gene_tabs_id}-panel-{gene_idx}-{gene_safe}"
                gene_tab_id = f"{gene_tabs_id}-tab-{gene_idx}-{gene_safe}"
                active = "true" if gene_idx == 0 else "false"
                active_class = " active" if gene_idx == 0 else ""
                hidden = "" if gene_idx == 0 else " hidden"

                html_parts.append(
                    f"<button class='gene-tab{active_class}' id='{gene_tab_id}' type='button' role='tab' "
                    f"aria-selected='{active}' aria-controls='{gene_panel_id}' data-target='{gene_panel_id}'>"
                    f"{gene}</button>"
                )

                uri = image_data_uri(p)
                gene_panels.append(
                    f"<div class='gene-tab-panel{active_class}' id='{gene_panel_id}' role='tabpanel' tabindex='0'{hidden}>"
                    f"<figure class='resolution-figure'><img src='{uri}' alt='Normalized expression violin plot for {gene} at Leiden resolution {resolution_name}'></figure>"
                    "<p><strong>How to read it.</strong> Compare the distribution across clusters, including the median/mean and the spread or fraction of expressing cells. A marker is more informative when expression is enriched in a coherent subset rather than broadly distributed across all clusters.</p>"
                    "</div>"
                )

            html_parts.append("</div>")
            html_parts.extend(gene_panels)
            html_parts.append("</div>")

        html_parts.extend(["</div>", "</details>"])

    display(HTML("".join(html_parts)))
```

```{python}
all_pngs = sorted(list(QC_DIR.rglob("*.png")) + list(CLUSTER_DIR.rglob("*.png"))) if (QC_DIR.exists() or CLUSTER_DIR.exists()) else []

def classify_png(p):

    if CLUSTER_DIR in p.parents:
        return "Clustering"
    return "Other"
```

# Reproducibility notes

The saved `PipelineConfig` is the configuration snapshot used to initialize the run, and `PathConfig` derives standardized folders from the working directory. The pipeline saves AnnData checkpoints, QC figures, clustering outputs, the doublet-detection object, and `analysis_metadata` under the run directory. This report reads those existing artifacts rather than recomputing the analysis.

::: {.callout-important}
### Scope of this report

The report describes the supplied implementation as written. In particular, it does not infer quality thresholds, cluster identities, cell-type labels, or biological conclusions from the generated figures. Those decisions remain analysis-specific and should be made from the data, experiment design, and appropriate external biological references.
:::
